spark: Marta deserted her company at the siege of a river fort, and the captain who had trusted her was captured and never ransomed

focal.name: Marta of the Marches
focal.who: A hard-eyed human soldier who keeps her own watch.
focal.backstory: Marta of the Marches slipped away from her company on the third night of a siege at a river fort. The captain who had trusted her with the gate was taken, and no one ever paid his ransom.

note: personal set pers1 (round T, North Star item 0): one of 8 company soldiers with a varied one-line past (the spark = the backstory's first sentence, as the game's personalSeed reads it)
